text.en: Asha asked whether all countries have the same government. "No," said her teacher.

Governments are of different forms. In a unitary government, power rests with the central government, as in the United Kingdom, while in a federal government power is divided between the centre and the states, as in India and the USA.
Governments may also be parliamentary or presidential. In the parliamentary system, as in India, the executive is responsible to the legislature. In the presidential system, as in the USA, the President is elected separately and is both head of state and head of government.
The three organs of government are the legislature that makes laws, the executive that carries them out and the judiciary that interprets them.
